crossRefs.note: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened, and heard, and a book of memory was written…
I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened…

translations.web: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.
translations.bsb: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.
translations.kjv: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none
translations.asv: Thine eyes did see mine unformed substance; And in thy book they were all written, Even the days that were ordained for me, When as yet there was none of them.
